data.name: Sissie
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word ‘sitos’, meaning ‘food’, Sissie can be translated to ‘little’ or ‘devoted one’. The name was traditionally given to girls who were named after their mother or grandmother, implying a deep sense of love and devotion. In Christian tradition, Sissie is reminiscent of the faithful and loving disciples who followed Jesus, and the name is often given to girls who embody these virtues.
